name: videomind-ai
description: VideoMind AI - run backend and frontend together

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix Frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix Frontend && npm test --prefix Frontend
